content.short: DeTask rewards valuable and timely work by paying for value.
content.description: IT projects face challenges meeting deadlines, budgets, and promised features, and executives often feel incentives to retain employees are lacking. DeTask uses blockchain to recognize top talent by paying for value delivered rather than hours worked. Our approach rewards efficient and timely project deliveries with extra incentives, aligning compensation with outcomes and helping teams stay motivated in a post-COVID labor landscape.
content.meta: DeTask rewards top talent by paying for value, not hours. Discover DeTask and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
